 1 | Work Stone | caster | 24 hrs | self | F

 8 | Make Steel | caster | 24 hrs | self | F

50 | Make/Work | caster | 24 hrs | self | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to flawlessly work non-magical stone, creating items with a -50
to +0 bonus (in combat). All required tools and materials must be present. The
time required to work the stone is halved.
@@ 2
As Work Stone, except non-magical base metals such as copper, iron, tin, lead,
etc., can be worked. This spell does not allow the working of hard iron. Items
created with the metals from this spell have bonuses that range from -30 to
-10.
@@ 3
As Work Stone, except non-magical base alloys such as brass, bronze, pewter,
etc., (but not iron alloys) can be worked. Items created with the metals from
this spell have bonuses that range from -15 to +0.
@@ 4
As Work Stone, except non-magical hard iron can be worked. Items created with
the metals from this spell have a bonus of +0.
@@ 5
As Work Stone, except non-magical low-carbon steel can be worked. Items
created with the metals from this spell have a bonus of +5.
@@ 6
For the duration of this spell, the caster can make base alloys from base
metals (but not steel from iron). The amount of the alloy that can be make
depends on the available supplies and equipment.
@@ 7
As Work Stone, except non-magical high carbon steel can be worked. Items
created with the metals from this spell have a bonus of +10.
@@ 8
For the duration of this spell, the caster can make steel from iron. The
amount of steel that can be make depends on the available supplies and
equipment.
@@ 10
As Work Stone, except non-magical white alloy steel can be worked. Items
created with the metals from this spell have a bonus of +15.
@@ 11
As Work Stone, except non-magical gemstones can be worked.
@@ 13
As Work Stone, except non-magical white alloy steel can be worked. Items
created with the metals from this spell have a bonus of +20.
@@ 15
As Work Stone, except Mithril can be worked. Must be cast in conjunction with
a Weapon V, Armor V, or General V spell, or the Weapon V, Armor V, or General
V spell will fail.
@@ 20
As Work Stone, except Laen can be worked. Must be cast in conjunction with a
Weapon VI, Armor VI, or General VI spell, or the Weapon VI, Armor VI, or
General VI spell will fail. (Note that such spells may need the aid of a
deity, demon, or other powerful magical being).
@@ 25
As Work Stone, except Eog can be worked. Must be cast in conjunction with a
Weapon VI, Armor VI, or General VI, or greater spell, or the Weapon VI, Armor
VI, or General VI (or greater) spell will fail. (Note that such spells may
need the aid of a deity, demon, or other powerful magical being).
@@ 50
Allows the caster to make and work any metal, alloy, or inorganic material. If
the material is enchanted it must be cast in conjunction with a Weapon, Armor,
or General spell of corresponding power (e.g., a magical substance that yields
a +10 bonus would require an Weapon II, Armor II, or General II). (Some such
spells may need the aid of a deity, demon, or other powerful magical being)
